scope: Isolated local H264 video-carrier foundation; not a live provider or production tunnel test

sources.title: RFC 6184: RTP Payload Format for H.264 Video

carrier.payload: SEI payloadType 5, fixed 16-byte UUID and at most 16384 binary bytes
carrier.picture: Real encoder-generated synthetic black 16x16 SPS/PPS/IDR fixture
carrier.framing: RBSP payload length before emulation-prevention insertion; mandatory trailing bits; bounded strict decoder
carrier.rtp: Single NAL, STAP-A and FU-A with bounded complete access-unit reconstruction, sequence gaps discard damaged units

validation.independentDecoder: Existing installed Google Chrome WebCodecs VideoDecoder, isolated E-drive profile, loopback-only page

limits.note: This proves standards-framed synthetic video survives local WebRTC RTP and decodes. It does not establish that any provider retains SEI metadata, that video is faster than audio, or that a complete authenticated tunnel is implemented.

storage: All generated media, build outputs and browser profiles were on E:. Installed encoder/browser on C: were read without modification. Temporary browser profiles created by the test were closed and removed.
